description: Envelope-draw era. Equal odds among lottery teams for their full draft order. Exact official joint probabilities for intermediate picks are coarser than in later eras.
Weighted-ball era using 66 combinations. Top 3 picks drawn; remainder fall by inverse record order.
Weighted 14-ball system with 1,000 combinations. Top 3 picks drawn; remainder fall by inverse record order.
Modern weighted system with flattened top-3 odds (14.0/14.0/14.0). Top 4 picks drawn; remainder fall by inverse record order.
